questions.stem: What are numbers that have only 1 as a common factor called?
questions.solution: Co-prime numbers are numbers that have only 1 as a common factor, meaning they share no other divisors. Even and odd numbers are classified based on divisibility by 2, not their common factors. Twin prime numbers are pairs of prime numbers that differ by 2, which is unrelated to having only 1 as a common factor.

questions.stem: Which of the following are pairs of co-primes?
questions.solution: The pair (7, 11) are co-prime because their only common factor is 1. The other pairs, (4, 6), (5, 10), and (9, 15), each have a common factor greater than 1, such as 2, 5, and 3 respectively, which disqualifies them from being co-prime.

questions.stem: What is the HCF of 24 and 32?
questions.solution: The highest common factor (HCF) of 24 and 32 is 8 because both numbers are divisible by 8, and no higher number divides both. Option 4 is too small as both numbers have more in common. Option 6 is not a factor of 32. Option 12 is not a factor of 24.

questions.stem: What is the LCM of 60 and 48?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 240 because it is the smallest number that both 60 and 48 divide into without leaving a remainder. 120 is too small as it does not divide evenly by 48. 360 and 480 are larger than necessary, making 240 the least common multiple.

hi.stem: 60 और 48 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य क्या है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 240 है क्योंकि यह वह सबसे छोटी संख्या है जिसमें 60 और 48 बराबर बांट जाते हैं। 120 बहुत छोटा है क्योंकि यह 48 में बराबर बांट नहीं जाता। 360 और 480 आवश्यकता से बड़े हैं, जिसके कारण 240 लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य होता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology.

mr.solution: बरोबर उत्तर 240 आहे कारण ते 60 आणि 48 दोन्ही ने भाग जाते आणि शिल्लक राहत नाही. 120 लहान आहे कारण 48 ने ते बरोबर भाग जात नाही. 360 आणि 480 आवश्यकतेपेक्षा मोठे आहेत, त्यामुळे 240 हा लघुतम सामाईक अपवर्तक आहे.
